name: cafeqr-root
description: CafeQR — Smart Digital Menu & Table Ordering System

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.render-build: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:push && npm run prisma:seed && npm run build
scripts.prisma:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push --schema=../prisma/schema.prisma
